title: Learning About POPs
summary: Official Derivative overview for Point Operators, covering POP concepts, point/primitive/vertex lists, attributes, rendering POPs, POP examples, and the OP Snippets POP Concepts path.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs conceptual grounding for POP data shape, attribute classes, POP rendering, or official POP examples.
POPs start as points with attributes and can represent particles, point clouds, polygons, lines, spline curves, geometry, and data points.
A POP has point, primitive, and vertex lists; the common point position attribute is P.
POPs can be rendered by Render TOP or sent to external systems such as DMX, LED arrays, lasers, and related workflows.
For live examples, use the POPs Examples Package Overview.toe and Help > Operator Snippets > POP Concepts.
